# Context

This script uses Medicare encounters and TAF claims to identify individuals with substance use disorder. The diagnosis and procedure codes that identify these conditions are provided in the following look-up table:  
  
- sud_codes.RData   
  
SUD codes were derived from [Chronic Conditions Data Warehouse Other Chronic Health, Mental Health, and Potentially Disabling Conditions Algorithms](https://www2.ccwdata.org/web/guest/condition-categories-other) for the following conditions:  

- Alcohol use disorder  
- Drug use disorders  
- Opioid use disorder  
  
Individuals with at least 1 inpatient claim OR 2 other non-drug claims of any service type with diagnosis codes in any position, OR at least one claim with a relevant procedure or national drug code, were flagged as having the condition. When two claims are required, they must occur at least one day apart.    
  
This code assumes the user has bound Medicare encounters and TAF claims into two tables (one inpatient that consists of MA Inpatient, TAF Inpatient, and TAF Long-term files called "ip_dat"; and one outpatient that consists of MA Outpatient, MA Carrier, and TAF Other Services files called "op_dat") with the following columns in each:  
   
- bene_id  
- claim_id  
- claim begin date  
- claim end date  
- diagnosis codes (all available diagnosis columns from each file type, including e codes)  
- ICD procedure code  
- HCPCS code  
- national drug code (ndc)  
  
  
# Load libraries

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)  
```


# Load SUD code lookup table  

This file includes lists of diagnosis, procedure, and ndc codes for CCW Other Chronic Condition algorithms of opioid use disorder, drug use disorder, and alcohol use disorder.  

```{r}
load("sud_codes.RData")
```


# Write functions

## Flag diagnosis codes  

This function flags each claim row with an indicator for alcohol use disorder (AUD), drug use disorder (DUD), opioid use disorder (OUD), or opioid-related hospital/ED visit based on CCW diagnosis code lists. It has 3 inputs:  

- `dt` = The claims data to flag  
- `col_names` = A list of column names that contain diagnosis codes to search  
- `ccw_sud` = The ccw_sud code lookup table previously loaded  

```{r}
set_sud_flags_dx <- function(dt, col_names, ccw_sud) {
  
  for (col in col_names) {
    
    stopifnot(length(dt[[col]]) == nrow(dt))
    
    # aud flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$aud$diagnosis$icd10, sud_aud_dx := TRUE]
    
    # dud flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$dud$diagnosis$icd10, sud_dud_dx := TRUE]
    
    # oud #2 (diagnosis code) flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$oud$diagnosis$icd10, sud_oud_dx := TRUE]
    
    # oud #3 (diagnosis code) flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$oud$hospital_ed$icd10, sud_oud_hosp_dx := TRUE]
  
  }
}
```


## Flag procedure codes

This function flags each claim row with an indicator for alcohol use disorder (AUD), drug use disorder (DUD), opioid use disorder (OUD) based on CCW procedure code lists. It has 3 inputs:  

- `dt` = The claims data to flag  
- `col_names` = A list of column names that contain procedure codes to search  
- `ccw_sud` = The ccw_sud code lookup table previously loaded  

```{r}
set_sud_flags_proc <- function(dt, col_names, ccw_sud) {
  
  for (col in col_names) {
    
    stopifnot(length(dt[[col]]) == nrow(dt))
    
    # aud flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$aud$procedure$icd10, sud_aud_proc := TRUE]
    
    # dud flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$dud$procedure$icd10, sud_dud_proc := TRUE]
    
    # oud #2 (procedure codes) flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$oud$procedure$icd10, sud_oud_proc := TRUE]
    
    # oud #4 (medication assisted therapy) flag
    dt[get(col) %in% ccw_sud$oud$mat$hcpcs, sud_oud_mat_hcpcs := TRUE]
    
  }
}
```


# Initiate new flags  

Here we create the new aud, sud, and oud flags and set the values to FALSE. We use the functions above to identify cases where the criteria is met and change the value to TRUE. 

Note: Flags based on ndc codes ('sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe', 'sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt') do not have a separate function. 

```{r}
new_cols <- c('sud_aud_dx', 'sud_oud_dx', 'sud_oud_hosp_dx', 'sud_dud_dx',            # dx flags (4)
              'sud_aud_proc','sud_dud_proc', 'sud_oud_proc', 'sud_oud_mat_hcpcs',     # proc_cd flags (4)
              'sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe', 'sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt')                         # ndc flags (2)

ip_dat[, (new_cols):= FALSE]
op_dat[, (new_cols):= FALSE]
```


## Flag diagnosis codes

```{r}
# inpatient claims
set_sud_flags_dx(ip_dat, paste0("icd_dgns_cd", 1:25), ccw_sud)

# outpatient claims
set_sud_flags_dx(op_dat, paste0("icd_dgns_cd", 1:25), ccw_sud)
```


## Flag diagnosis e-codes

```{r}
#inpatient claims
set_sud_flags_dx(ip_dat, paste0("dgns_e_cd", 1:10), ccw_sud)

# outpatient claims
set_sud_flags_dx(op_dat, paste0("dgns_e_cd", 1:10), ccw_sud)
```


## Flag procedure codes

```{r}
# inpatient ICD procedure codes
set_sud_flags_proc(ip_dat, paste0("icd_prcdr_cd", 1:13), ccw_sud)

# inpatient HCPCS codes
set_sud_flags_proc(ip_dat, "hcpcs_cd", ccw_sud) 

# outpatient ICD procedure codes
set_sud_flags_proc(op_dat, paste0("icd_prcdr_cd", 1:13), ccw_sud)

# outpatient HCPCS codes
set_sud_flags_proc(op_dat, "hcpcs_cd", ccw_sud) 
```


## Flag national drug codes

```{r}
# inpatient
ip_dat[ndc %in% ccw_sud$oud$mat$ndc$buprenorphine, sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe := TRUE]
ip_dat[ndc %in% ccw_sud$oud$mat$ndc$naltrexone, sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt := TRUE]

# outpatient
op_dat[ndc %in% ccw_sud$oud$mat$ndc$buprenorphine, sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe := TRUE]
op_dat[ndc %in% ccw_sud$oud$mat$ndc$naltrexone, sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt := TRUE]
```


# Roll flags to the claim-level

```{r}
# inpatient
ip_flags <- ip_dat[, lapply(.SD, max, na.rm = TRUE),
                     by = .(bene_id, claim_id, claim_begin_dt, claim_end_dt),
                     .SDcols = patterns("^sud_")]

# outpatient
op_flags <- op_dat[, lapply(.SD, max, na.rm = TRUE),
                     by = .(bene_id, claim_id, claim_begin_dt, claim_end_dt),
                     .SDcols = patterns("^sud_")]
```


# Count claims

```{r}
# inpatient
ip_flags <- ip_flags[, lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     by = .(bene_id),
                     .SDcols = patterns("^sud_")]

# outpatient
# check for overlapping claim dates
op_flags[, contiguous := chse::overlapping(start = claim_begin_dt,
                                           end = claim_end_dt,
                                           maxgap = 0), by = .(bene_id)]
# aggregate overlapping claim dates
op_flags <- op_flags[, lapply(.SD, max, na.rm = TRUE),
                     by = .(bene_id, contiguous),
                     .SDcols = patterns("^sud_")]

# count number of unique encounters
op_flags <- op_flags[, lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE),
                     by = .(bene_id),
                     .SDcols = patterns("^sud_")]
```


# Create unique beneficiary table

```{r}
# create table of unique bene)ids and join flags
benes <- unique(rbind(ip_flags[, .(bene_id)], 
                      op_flags[, .(bene_id)]))  %>%
  
  # join inpatient flags  
  left_join(ip_flags %>% 
              rename_with(.cols = matches("^sud_"), ~ paste0("ip_", .x)), 
            by = c("bene_id")) %>%
  
  # join outpatient flags 
  left_join(op_flags %>% 
              rename_with(.cols = matches("^sud_"), ~ paste0("op_", .x)), 
            by = c("bene_id"))  %>%
  mutate(across(matches("_sud_"), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)))
```


# Create final SUD flags

- At least 1 inpatient claim OR 2+ other non-drug claims of any service type  
- Procedure and NDC codes require only one claim to qualify  

```{r}
sud_flags <- benes %>% 
  
  summarise(across(matches("_sud_"), ~ sum(.x)),
            .by = c("bene_id")) %>% 
  
          # aud flags
  mutate(sud_aud = ip_sud_aud_dx >= 1 | 
                   ip_sud_aud_proc >= 1 |
                   op_sud_aud_dx >= 2 |
                   op_sud_aud_proc >= 1,
         
         # dud flags
         sud_dud = ip_sud_dud_dx >= 1 | 
                   ip_sud_dud_proc >= 1 |
                   op_sud_dud_dx >= 2 |
                   op_sud_dud_proc >= 1,
         
         # oud #2
         sud_oud2 = ip_sud_oud_dx >= 1 | 
                    ip_sud_oud_proc >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_dx >= 2 |
                    op_sud_oud_proc >= 1,
         
         # oud #3
         sud_oud3 = ip_sud_oud_hosp_dx >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_hosp_dx >= 2,
         
         # oud #4
         sud_oud4 = ip_sud_oud_mat_hcpcs >= 1 |
                    ip_sud_oud_mat_hcpcs_meth >= 1 |
                    ip_sud_oud_mat_cpt_meth  >= 1 |
                    ip_sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe >= 1 |
                    ip_sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_mat_hcpcs >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_mat_hcpcs_meth >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_mat_cpt_meth >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_mat_ndc_bupe >= 1 |
                    op_sud_oud_mat_ndc_nalt >= 1) %>%
  
  mutate(sud = sud_aud | sud_dud | sud_oud2 | sud_oud3 | sud_oud4) %>%
  as.data.table()
```
